intent: Ride three paddle-wheel carousels and the great wheel itself; sluice currents push and drag over bramble basins while icicle drips fall through the machinery. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The riverside path
sections.lesson: Ride the sluice current, hop the root beds. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The riverside path
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The mill approach
sections.lesson: Board the paddle wheel to the sluice walk. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The mill approach
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: Sunlight on the waterwheel
sections.lesson: Ride the great wheel to the high sluice. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:

sections.name: Behind the mill
sections.lesson: Mind the dripping machinery and the sluice tongues. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The rocky upstream
sections.lesson: One last wheel before the rocks. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
